description:
ChaCha20-Poly1305 authenticated encryption with associated data (RFC 8439), in pure V.

No unsafe blocks, no C interop: the ChaCha20 permutation, the Poly1305 message authentication code (including its 2^130 - 5 modular reduction) and the AEAD construction are implemented directly from the specification, and every fallible path returns a V result.
name: gil-silva.chacha20po
